name: When do I need a professional electrician for my home in Berkeley?
description: You need a professional electrician for flickering lights, tripped breakers, burning smells, or major appliance installations.

mainEntity.name: When do I need a professional electrician for my home in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need a professional electrician in Berkeley if you experience flickering lights, frequently tripped breakers, unusual burning smells from outlets, or if you're planning a major appliance installation or renovation. These are signs of potential electrical problems that require expert attention for safety and compliance.
